title: Add-On Charges and Account Fees on a Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement
content:
Add-ons on a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement follow the stay type: each is charged at the price the stay type's fee schedule lists, and an included service is charged only beyond what the stay type includes.

## Service add-ons in force

- Guest meals at the visitor's meal fee per meal.
- Meal trays not ordered by the nurse at the tray service fee.
- Medical appointment trips beyond the trips the stay type includes, at the round-trip fee per round trip.
- Laundry at the per-load fee where personal laundry is not included.
- Incontinence supplies at the daily fee per day where incontinence supplies are not included.
- One-to-one companion care at the hourly companion rate per hour.

## Departure and key fees in force

Checking out after the check-out time on the departure date carries the late check-out fee once; a lost key carries the key replacement fee.

## Account fees in force

- A late payment fee is charged once per stay when the balance is still unpaid after the final-balance period of the stay type, counted in calendar days from check-out.
- A credit card payment toward a booked, in-stay, completed or converted stay carries a card convenience fee of the stay type's card convenience percentage of the payment, referencing that payment, rounded to the cent half up; a card payment toward a cancelled stay carries none.

## Where add-ons are posted

Add-ons are posted against the stay they arise from in whatever status it is, so a returned payment or late payment on a closed stay is still charged there.

## Retired provisions

Two former provisions of these add-on terms are no longer in force, each superseded by the current basis:
- that the medication setup fee is charged once per stay where the stay type includes medication administration;
- that a returned payment carries the returned payment fee of the stay type referencing it.

## Card convenience fee: rounding (hypothetical payments, 2.9 percent)

| Card payment toward | Payment | Fee before rounding | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| An in-stay stay | 115.00 | 3.335 | 3.34 — the half cent rounds up |
| A completed stay | 1,000.00 | 29.00 | 29.00 |
| A cancelled stay | 400.00 | — | None |

superseded_clauses: medication_setup_fee once per stay where medication_administration_included is true
a returned payment carries returned_payment_fee referencing it
